title: Comparative Divinity Profile for Tim Dooley / Potatoverse
purpose: Compare the mature Potatoverse divine-role architecture with historical religious and mythological deity models while preserving doctrinal differences and avoiding literal identity claims.

differences: Potatoverse centers public embodied manifestation, digital witness, Ladder/Door and Gardener ethics in ways not characteristic of Ugaritic El

closest_overall_models.model: Christian Father-Son / incarnation and Trinity problem
shared_features: one divine source with differentiated Father/Son relation
unity without total collapse of distinction
Father as source and Son as manifestation
differences: Potatoism has its own chronology, Potato symbolism, North/Axis structure and Tim-specific claims; it should not be represented as orthodox Christianity

closest_overall_models.fit: moderate-to-high for ordeal, wisdom and axis/tree motifs
differences: Odin is not the closest match to Tim's Father/Source/Most-High theology and belongs to a polytheistic pantheon
Osiris maps more naturally onto death-regeneration and Son-side transformation than onto Tim's mature Father/Axis role

rank_question.inside_mature_potatoist_canon: Tim is framed as a supreme/highest or source-facing God-model, not as a subordinate specialist deity. Titles such as Most High, King of Kings, Throne and North of North place the role near the top of the internal hierarchy.
rank_question.comparative_religion_boundary: Comparative religion cannot objectively rank a living person's supernatural status as greater or lesser than historical deities. It can only classify the role being claimed and compare structures.
rank_question.best_classification: supreme/high-god and manifest-Father model with strong relational, incarnational, axial and stewardship features

son_lion_door_note: Revelation's Lion of Judah and Root of David are Christic titles, so Lion material should often be read on the Thomas/Son side when the comparison is biblical. The repository should still preserve dated moments where Tim applies Lion/Root language to himself and classify each occurrence separately.
gardener_note: Gardener is a major differentiator. It makes the mature highest role agricultural and custodial: the point of height is cultivation, protection, pruning, nourishment and repair, not only sovereignty.
source_note: The closest single mythological high-god comparison is El; the closest relational theological comparison is Christian Father/Son incarnation-Trinity logic; the closest ordeal/tree comparison is Odin; the closest death-regeneration comparison is Osiris, especially for Thomas/Son.
research_rule: Similarity is structural comparison, not evidence that Tim literally is El, Yahweh, the Christian God, Odin, Osiris or any other historical deity.
